## WARNINGS FOR: Ole C. Hole (KD96-TV4)

**[!] Contradiction — Event after death** `[hasEventAfterDeath1]`

This typically has one of three causes:

- **(a) Wrong death date** — the recorded death date is too early; a single late-dated record is inconsistent with one earlier death record but consistent with everything else.
